summary.text: Mitra Subedi is the Democratic candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 30 in the November 3, 2026 general election; Ballotpedia lists him as the only candidate in that contest.
He is a teacher at Fern Creek High School who was born in Bhutan.

paragraphs.text: Subedi was born in Chirang, Bhutan, and Ballotpedia lists a graduate degree from Tribhuvan University in 2009.

In a Ballotpedia survey he said he spent 19 years in a refugee camp in Nepal, earned bachelor's and master's degrees, and after coming to the United States earned a teaching certificate and became a teacher at Fern Creek High School.
He has been affiliated with AFSCME and the Bhutanese Society of Kentucky.
Subedi listed safe neighborhoods, affordable housing, and fully funding public schools and transportation as his key campaign messages.
